notes.scope: Task 9 of feature 05-projects — frontend layout composition only. Reviewed commit af9d401. Single tracked file changed: frontend/layouts/default.vue (+10 lines). The accompanying ux-guidelines.md edit lives under .claude/ which is gitignored locally and contains no executable code, so it is not part of the security surface.

owaspCoverage.A01_BrokenAccessControl: N/A — layout adds a v-if-guarded sidebar link to /projects/[id]/settings. Access enforcement happens upstream in frontend/middleware/auth.global.ts (unchanged, zero-touch contract held) and on the backend (SecurityConfig.java, ProjectController — also unchanged). The link is purely presentational; it cannot grant access.
owaspCoverage.A02_CryptographicFailures: N/A — no crypto, no secrets, no key material added.
owaspCoverage.A03_Injection_XSS: Verified safe. projectsStore.currentProject.id is a server-issued MongoDB @Id (see backend/src/main/java/com/botfunnel/project/Project.java) populated only from GET /api/v1/projects via the typed Project interface (frontend/types/project.ts). It is not user-controlled free text. The template uses :to binding on NuxtLinkLocale, which routes through vue-router and URL-encodes path segments into an <a href> attribute — not raw HTML interpolation. Vue's {{ }} interpolation is HTML-escaped by default. No XSS risk in this diff.
owaspCoverage.A04_InsecureDesign: N/A — pure UI composition. No business logic, no trust-boundary changes. Conditional render via v-if="projectsStore.currentProject" matches the spec contract (no Settings link when no project is selected).
owaspCoverage.A05_SecurityMisconfiguration: N/A — no headers, CORS, config, or environment changes.
owaspCoverage.A06_VulnerableComponents: N/A — no dependencies added or upgraded. package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml not touched.
owaspCoverage.A07_AuthenticationFailures: Verified safe. The global route middleware (auth.global.ts) runs before any layout renders and fail-closes unauthenticated users to /auth/login. currentProject is only populated after an authenticated /api/v1/projects request resolves; the Settings link cannot render in an unauthenticated context. The destination route /projects/[id]/settings is itself behind the same global middleware. The onLogout flow (lines 10–17) and authStore wiring are unchanged.
owaspCoverage.A08_SoftwareAndDataIntegrity: N/A — no deserialization, no dynamic imports, no CI/CD changes.
owaspCoverage.A09_SecurityLoggingAndMonitoring: N/A — no log surface introduced or removed.
owaspCoverage.A10_SSRF: N/A — client-side template only, no server-side fetch with user-controlled URL.

focusAreaConfirmations.xssViaTemplateInterpolation: Confirmed not exploitable. id is a server-issued UUID-shaped string from the backend Project entity (@Id, String). Even an attacker-controlled stored value would land URL-encoded in an href attribute via vue-router, not in an HTML body context.
focusAreaConfirmations.openRedirectOrLocalePrefixBypass: Confirmed not exploitable. The :to value is a static-prefix template `/projects/${id}/settings` with hardcoded leading `/projects/` and trailing `/settings`. No scheme, no `//` prefix, no host. NuxtLinkLocale preserves the locale prefix per project i18n pattern (no NuxtLink fallback was introduced).
focusAreaConfirmations.preMiddlewareLayoutRender: Not possible. defineNuxtRouteMiddleware in auth.global.ts is global and runs before page/layout render; layout reads authStore.user/projectsStore.currentProject which are null on the unauthenticated path, so the new Settings link does not render. Even if rendered, the target route is guarded by the same middleware.
focusAreaConfirmations.scopeCreepZeroTouch: Verified by git diff af9d401~1 af9d401 --name-only against frontend/middleware/auth.global.ts, backend/src/main/java/com/botfunnel/security/SecurityConfig.java, backend/src/main/java/com/botfunnel/jobs/JobRunrMongoConfig.java — none of these files appear in the commit. AC-T7 zero-touch contract holds.

notes.hardcodedSecretsScan: Clean. The 10-line diff introduces only: a Pinia store import, a store binding, a <ProjectSelector /> tag, and an i18n-keyed NuxtLinkLocale to a server-issued id. No API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings, private keys, or base64 credential-shaped blobs.
